newsitem.title: USA: EarthLink Network stake held by Soros.
newsitem.headline: EarthLink Network stake held by Soros.

text.p: A group led by investor George Soros said Monday it holds a 15.48 percent stake in EarthLink Network Inc or 1,475,435 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 539,000 common on January 22 at a price of $13 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
EarthLink, based in Pasadena, Calif., is an internet service provider that was formed to help users derive meaningful benefits for the extensive resources for the internet.
EarthLink made its market debut on January 22 after putting its Initial Public Offering on hold during July.
